exposure: Anteroposterior diameter (APD) of the levator ani muscle (LAM)
cohort: The study included 296 women with a gestational age of at least 37 weeks, carrying a single fetus in a cephalic presentation.
finding: Women with LAM coactivation were approximately three times more likely to undergo an operative vaginal delivery and over five times more likely to sustain a third-or fourth-degree tear during childbirth than women who exhibited normal relaxation of the LAM during the Valsalva maneuver.
mod_finding: Women with episiotomy had a significantly shorter median APD under Valsalva than women without perineal trauma.
